name: Parkour Motion Capture GLB (codepawl)
summary: 98 optical-mocap parkour clips (box vaults, trapezoid obstacles, balance beam, flips; 17 moves, ~59.6k frames at 60 fps) retargeted onto a free CC0 Quaternius character, each shipped with the obstacle it was captured on as GLB. Tiers for web (meshopt), mobile (KTX2), engine (Godot/Blender/Unreal mannequin bone names), animation-only and raw 15-joint skeleton. 60 clips pass contact checks; the rest are in a 'flagged' split with the reason.

access.notes: Credit required: hhtools Parkour Mocap by YaojieShen (Apache-2.0). Character: Quaternius Universal Base Characters, CC0. Clips in the 'flagged' split failed a contact/joint check; use with care.

procedure: Open the Hugging Face dataset page (no account needed).
Pick a tier folder: objects/ (web), mobile/, engine/ (Godot, Blender, Unreal), motion/ (animation only, load character/ once) or skeleton/ (raw source skeleton).
Download a clip's .glb directly, or clone the whole repo (~1.1 GB) with git/huggingface-cli.
Optional: preview clips in the viewer Space https://huggingface.co/spaces/codepawl/parkour-mocap-viewer

stats.size: ~1.1 GB repo; engine tier 690.8 MB, web tier 42.4 MB

verdict.why: Rare free mocap that ships with matching obstacle geometry, in engine-ready GLB tiers with permissive Apache-2.0 license and CC0 character; tested in three.js, Blender and Godot per the card. Minus: README has a few template glitches ('undefined m/s'), 38 clips flagged, no fingers.

image.alt: Several retargeted characters vaulting and climbing grey box and trapezoid obstacles in a 3D editor scene
